item.title: Away From the Desk: I Gave My Mac Agents a Phone Entrance, and Why "Yes, Merge It" on a Phone Doesn't Count
item.description: The last post was about the result file, how the coordinator and the executor hand work over. That setup works, but I skipped past a precondition at the time: the executor runs on my machine, so the human has to be at my machine too. Later I moved the heavy work back onto my own laptop, and that precondition turned into a daily problem — the work lives on the Mac, and I am often not in front of the Mac.
